plugInRules.territorialExtent: SI regs 1-2 (plug approval) extend to UK incl. NI; reg 3 (ESQCR) extends to GB only. Treat as GB-only (pluginsolarexplained: 'not currently legal in Northern Ireland').

hardwiredRules.note: Batteries (EcoFlow STREAM, Anker Solarbank 4 Pro, Zendure 2400, Hoymiles HiBattery) must be hardwired on a dedicated circuit by a Part P electrician with G98 notification. Total micro-generation incl. any plug-in device must stay <=16 A/phase or G99 applies.
